title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President

description.narrative: Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: Improved urban transport infrastructure. Indicator: One automatic multi-level car parking constructed in Jammu accommodating 720 cars with women-friendly facilities including separate restrooms each for males and females, closed-circuit TV system installed, and full lighting. Progress/Status: Completed. Data Source: Quarterly Progress reports of executing agency. Actual value:

Output: Improved water supply infrastructure. Indicator: 18 km new pipelines constructed to increase transmission capacity by 13.45 million liter per day available in Srinagar. Progress/Status: Completed. Data Source: Quarterly Progress reports of executing agency. Actual value:

Output: Improved water supply infrastructure. Indicator: 22 km new pipeline constructed to provide 1,000 new households water connections in Jammu (Target: 13% BPL households and 8% FHHs). Progress/Status: Completed. Data Source: Quarterly Progress reports of executing agency. Actual value:

Output: Improved water supply infrastructure. Indicator: 265 km old dilapidated water pipelines rehabilitated in Jammu to provide increased water supply to an estimated 53,000 households in Jammu, of which 13% are BPL households and 8% are FHHs (coverage area includes 13% poor/low income households; 8% FHHs). Progress/Status: Nearly completed. To be reviewed and updated at PCR. Data Source: Quarterly Progress reports of executing agency. Actual value:

Output: Improved water supply infrastructure. Indicator: NRW reduction program piloted in an area of 3,000 consumers in Jammu.. Progress/Status: Achieved. Data Source: Quarterly Progress reports of executing agency. Actual value:

Output: Improved drainage infrastructure. Indicator: 26.42 km of drains constructed in Srinagar to reduce flooding that affects 30,000 households (13% of which are BPL households and 8% are FHHs). Progress/Status: Nearly completed. To be reviewed and updated at PCR. Data Source: Periodic progress reports of executing agency. Baseline year: 2013 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2013 Baseline value: N Target year: 2016 Target value: Y

Output: Improved drainage infrastructure. Indicator: Three new pumping stations constructed in Srinagar. Progress/Status: Completed. Data Source: Periodic progress reports of executing agency. Baseline year: 2013 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2013 Baseline value: N Target year: 2016 Target value: Y

Output: Improved urban transport infrastructure. Indicator: 120 m long 2-lane reinforced cement concrete bridge, and 340 m and 408 m long two 2-lane grade separators constructed in Srinagar. Progress/Status: Nearly completed. To be reviewed and updated at PCR. Data Source: Quarterly Progress reports of executing agency. Baseline year: 2013 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2013 Baseline value: N Target year: 2016 Target value: Y

Output: Institutional capacity of the Srinagar and Jammu Municipal Corporations improved. Indicator: Organizational Development Plans for Srinagar and Jammu municipal corporations adopted. Progress/Status: Ongoing. To be reviewed and updated at PCR. Data Source: Periodic progress reports of executing agency. Baseline year: 2013 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2013 Baseline value: N Target year: 2016 Target value: Y

Output: Institutional capacity of the Srinagar and Jammu Municipal Corporations improved. Indicator: Systems established to generate annual financial statements for the municipal corporations of Jammu and Srinagar. Progress/Status: Ongoing. To be reviewed and updated at PCR. Data Source: Periodic progress reports of executing agency. Baseline year: 2013 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2013 Baseline value: N Target year: 2016 Target value: Y
improved urban services in Jammu and Srinagar.

Average travel time reduced to 10 minutes from Shalamar Chow to Shadhidi Chow (baseline = 20 minutes in 2013). Progress/Status: To be reviewed and updated at PCR. Data Source: Quarterly projecr progress reports of executing agency. Actual value:

Average water supply increased to 135 l/d/capita for 21,000 people (48% female) in another area of Jammu through new pipeline (baseline = 20 l/d/capita in 2013 for the area). Progress/Status: To be reviewed and updated at PCR. Data Source: Quarterly projecr progress reports of executing agency. Actual value:

Average travel time reduced to 15 minutes from Dal gate to Lal Chow (baseline = 30 minutes in 2013). Progress/Status: To be reviewed and updated at PCR. Data Source: Quarterly projecr progress reports of executing agency. Actual value:

Average water supply increased to 135 l/d/capita for 185,000 people (48% female) in Srinagar (baseline = 60 l/d/capita in 2013 for the area). Progress/Status: To be reviewed and updated at PCR. Data Source: Quarterly projecr progress reports of executing agency. Actual value:

Average water supply increased to 135 l/d/capita for 261,000 people (48% female) in one area of Jammu through rehabilitation of pipelines (baseline = 90 l/d/capita in 2013). Progress/Status: To be reviewed and updated at PCR. Data Source: Quarterly projecr progress reports of executing agency. Actual value:

Water logging reduced to 0.3 hours for 1 day in a year in the project area of Srinagar (baseline = 2 hours for 25-30 days in a year in 2013). Progress/Status: To be reviewed and updated at PCR. Data Source: Quarterly projecr progress reports of executing agency. Base year: 2013 Baseline value: N
